selection: Start with all eight existing questions. Score every one-question removal with pooled four-fold real inner predictions and original .05-step thresholds. F2 path accepts only strict F2 improvement (>1e-12); threshold ties favor precision/recall/higher threshold. Recall-guard path requires at least the current RF inner recall, minimizes false positives with ties by recall/precision/F2/higher threshold, and accepts only a strict FP reduction. Child ties follow original question order. Stop at first lack of strict improvement or one remaining question. Cache identical subsets across both paths.
interpretation: Freeze the current RF's original outer-training-selected parameters, High weight and augmentation ratio. Reuse original folds and full-eight synthetic generator; project encoded questions as whole groups. No global feature ranking or removal based on prior error tables. The entire greedy path and stopping rule use training data only; outer evaluation remains real-only. Inner recall is not an outer guarantee. Conditional greedy search, not exhaustive subset/model optimization; repeated exploration on 97 students.
